issue_request: FHIR-6206 is a Published/Persuasive PC technical correction for the DSTU1 FamilyHistory artifact. It reported that the display/narrative text for the example with <id value="mother"/> was wrong because the example should describe only one family member per resource.
initial_application: The Jira comments say the issue was applied in svn revision 5624. The matching git-svn commit is 6e3cb1000d7e91569a2ad1226eda79a33deb1197, whose subject appears to typo the tracker as #6306 but whose git-svn-id is build@5624 and whose patch removed "Brother has diabetes" from source/familymemberhistory/familymemberhistory-example-mother.xml.
additional_context: FamilyHistory is now FamilyMemberHistory, and source/fhir.ini actively lists familymemberhistory as a PC resource. The mother example resource itself already contains only "Mother died of a stroke aged 56" and relationship display "mother", but source/familymemberhistory/list-FamilyMemberHistory-examples.xml still described FamilyMemberHistory/mother as "Mother died from a stroke aged 56. Brother with diabetes." Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence. Jira FHIR-6306 was discovered only because of the historical commit-subject typo and is an unrelated Vocab no-change issue.
